instruction: Use the already opened Bonsai/Blender IFC authoring environment and its CLI/API tools to update /home/user/Desktop/init.ifc and save the finished model as /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc. Bonsai is installed as a Blender extension, so start `/opt/blender/blender` and use the Bonsai tools from that environment. Do not create, rewrite, copy, patch, or post-process the IFC outside that software environment. The model is a small office shell with an open office and a meeting room separated by a partition. The cost planner needs a lightweight quantity handover that reflects the existing layout without changing the architectural geometry. Preserve the spaces, walls, slab, door/window fills, and openings, and add the practical floor, wall-side, and slab area quantities needed for an early estimate. Mark the measured spaces and building elements with revision code BONSAI-CLI-09.
